name: kolpa (C Framework)
description: The C99 game framework. Window, input, rendering (OpenGL), audio, and math. Forked from raylib and rebranded.

name: kolpa engine (C++ Layer)
description: The C++20 engine layer. ECS (flecs), scene management, physics (box3d), audio DSP, resource pipelines, and C# scripting.

name: Physics (box3d)
description: Rigid body physics behind a backend-agnostic C API. Box, sphere, capsule, cylinder, convex hull, triangle mesh, raycasting, and character controllers.

name: Audio System
description: Audio loading, playback, streaming, 3D spatial audio, audio buses, DSP filters, and reverb zones. Built on raudio.

name: C# Scripting
description: Optional .NET 10 integration. MonoBehaviours with hot reload via collectible AssemblyLoadContext. Unity-style Input class.

name: Scene System
description: Scene lifecycle hooks, deferred switching, JSON save/load, play/edit mode state, and the runtime shell.

name: Godot Level Editor
description: Godot 4 plugin that exports scenes to Kolpa's JSON format. The recommended level editor for Kolpa Engine.
